title: asq Office action receipt
description: The 200 body of every POST action — tell, note, stop, pause, resume, whip, gift, resolve, assign, spawn (data-contract.md §3 Receipt, §4). The client shows detail verbatim under the button.

delivered.description: typed = sent into a live tmux pane; board = filed as a board note; spawned = a new fleet agent started; none = nothing to deliver to (e.g. a stop that found no pane).

detail.description: One human sentence: "typed y + Enter into pane %14" / "filed as a board note to role coder".

agent_id.description: For spawn: the new agent's id (its label is in detail).

keys.description: v1.1 — exactly the tmux key names that were sent, in order, e.g. ["Down","Enter"]. This is the plan the back-end owns (§7); it is never ["y","Enter"] for a permission dialog, because the dialog is a radio list.

at.description: v1.1 — server time the action was applied.

closed.description: v1.3, optional. Whether the dialog was OBSERVED to leave the pane within 1 s of the keys being sent. true = observed gone; false = observed still there; null = not observed either way, which is the honest answer for a board delivery, a self session or a capture that did not come back in time. It is a statement about the pane, never a claim that the agent accepted the answer (§3 Receipt, §7).
